primary_cause: Capesize freight strength and demand were reported, but the durability and breadth of the cycle are conflicted by evidence that 2026 strength may be driven by temporary Hormuz rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially artificial, linked to forced rerouting around Hormuz, and could reverse as a supply glut emerges in 2027.
